explanation.headline: Labetalol hydrochloride is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; Corvale East has 26.3 days on hand and Corvale General has 21.6 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include labetalol hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 301 tablets of the 100 mg presentation with 11.4 tablets used per day, providing 26.3 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 297 tablets of the same presentation with 13.8 tablets used per day, providing 21.6 days on hand.
The product label for NDC 23155072305 identifies Heritage Pharma Labs Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Labs Inc. (FEI 3005139373) as the registered manufacturing plant.

FDA inspection records for that plant show multiple Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI) classifications from 2009 through 2018, with the most recent inspection ending 2018-02-06 and a known date of 2018-05-07.
The most recent inspection listed for the plant is a No Action Indicated (NAI) inspection dated 2023-09-19.

Buyer should verify current supply status with Advagen Pharma Ltd., Biocon Pharma Inc., and BluePoint Laboratories, which are ranked as alternate manufacturers but have no plant placement on their labels.
